reviews.text: I've used Halo for nearly 12 years now and have always had nothing but praise for them. Impeccable collection and delivery service, easy booking system and full b/marks from my dog!

An absolute hidden gem! We can’t wait to come back.

Our first visit to Halo Dogs at Holly Hilly Farm, and I’m so happy to have found it.

I messaged on the off chance we could book a session that same afternoon, fully expecting to be told no, but the team were so lovely and accommodating. It couldn’t have been easier to arrange.

We took our three dogs, one Doberman and two Cocker Spaniels, and I was blown away by the space. As a neurotic dog parent, security is my biggest concern, and I was genuinely reassured by how secure the field is. Even my leaping Doberman was safely contained, and the fencing at ground level gave me extra peace of mind with our smaller dogs, too.

Walking in and seeing all the different things for them to explore and play on genuinely made my day. There’s so much variety, from tunnels and tyres to mounds, logs and agility-style obstacles. I practise Hoopers with my dogs at home, but having access to proper tunnels and equipment without having to buy and store everything myself is fantastic. I can’t wait to come back and do more with them!

The practical touches are brilliant, too. Multiple water points, bowls ready to fill, and covered areas with picnic tables make it easy to settle in and enjoy your time there. It’s spacious, peaceful and somewhere you can just concentrate on your dogs having a good time.

I’m genuinely grateful to have found this place. Life gets busy, and I never want to look back one day and think, “I wish I’d done more with my boy.” Having somewhere like this to bring them, let them explore and give them new experiences means so much to me.

Our hour flew by, and we could happily have stayed longer. All three dogs had a brilliant time, and I was already thinking about our next visit before we’d even left.

Thank you to the team for making us feel so welcome. I honestly couldn’t recommend Halo Dogs enough. We’ll definitely be back! 🐾

Halo Dogs have looked after my dogs for the past 15 years, and I couldn’t recommend them highly enough.
My dogs have always loved going there — they get so excited in the mornings when they’re collected, which says it all!
The walkers are wonderful, very personable and genuinely build lovely relationships with the dogs. It’s reassuring to know they’re being so well looked after by people who really care about them.
I would highly recommend Halo Dogs for both their daycare and boarding services.

We rented the dog park at Halo Dogs (Holly Hill Farm) today and were very impressed! 🐾
It’s a fantastic, secure space where your dogs can roam freely and safely, with plenty of activities for both you and your dogs to enjoy. The prices are very reasonable too.
The whole family, dogs included, thoroughly enjoyed our time there. We’ll definitely be visiting again and would highly recommend it! 🐶❤️

Feels like I am sending my dog away on holiday! The dog collection/delivery service works well, and I see photos of what fun she is having. She's a retired racing greyhound and I sometimes think she misses having other dogs around.

We love Halo Dogs and would thoroughly recommend. A reliable, professional and flexible service with friendly staff who we trust. We are so appreciative of everything they do to care for our dog (Barbara)! Highly recommend!
Very fiendly service and they take great care of our Spaniel. He's also very excited to be picked up in the morning and when he stays over night we know he's well looked after.

Absolutley amazing experience with Halo Dogs! Leaving your dog anywhere can be nerve-wracking, but the team here goes above and beyond to make you feel completely at ease. The 540-acre countryside facility is pristine, spotlessly clean, and an absolute paradise for dogs. I love the regular updates and photos they send throughout the day—it gives so much peace of mind. My dog Bruno always comes home happy, thoroughly socialised, and pleasantly exhausted. The whole team are professional, friendly, and clearly adore what they do. Highly recommend them to any dog owner in North London and beyond!! Thank you for always caring about Bruno 🥰
Many happy years of our dog going to camp and boarding with Halo Dogs!

Milo has been attending Halo since he was 17 weeks old (now nearly 3). He attends once or twice a week, as well as having occasional overnight stays.

Halo gives us 100% piece of mind. Some people think Halo is expensive but for what they provide it is great value.

Milo loves gets so excited when he is picked up, especially when Bruno or Luke turn up: of course he loves all the staff. Sometimes we think he loves them more than us😂 Milo goes off without a look back and always returns home happy, and tired after a hard day socialising.

Milo has developed into a happy and confident dog, unfazed by others dogs no matter how big or small.

The staff at Halo are so dedicated and treat Milo like their own. We can relax knowing he is well cared for and doing lots of exciting things.

If we go away or out for an evening we know Milo is having a great time. Milo is very much an outdoors doggy, which is another reason why Halo suits him so well, there is so much outdoor space and he is kept well occupied.

Justin is always on hand to answer any  questions we may have and is our go to person.

I do not hesitate to recommend Halo to other dog owners when asked. Why not book an induction and make up your own mind, you won’t look back.

Happy Owners😀😀
